config.well.wellsPerChunk.tooltip: How many wells are allowed per chunk? If 0, unlimited wells are allowed. Well counts are separate for regular and upside-down wells.
config.well.playSound.tooltip: Play the well cranking sound when someone takes fluid from a well.
config.well.tankCapacity.tooltip: How many millibuckets of a fluid can wells hold? Set to 0 to disable.
config.well.allowWellFill.tooltip: When set to true, wells can be filled by buckets and pipes. Otherwise, wells can only be extracted from.
warn.well.wellsPerChunk: Too many wells in this chunk! The max is %s
warn.well.wellsPerChunkFlipped: Too many upside down wells in this chunk! The max is %s
